subject: Vendr onboarding: ephemeral upload window & CAIQ gap tracker
messages:
From: Sarah Murphy <sarah.murphy@vendr.com>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr security portal kickoff: scoped CAIQ and short upload window

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting the Vendr onboarding for Redwood and want to do a tight evidence sprint for CAIQ and SIG fragments. Our portal has a 72-hour ephemeral upload window for new accounts — after that the S3 upload token expires and we ask partners to re-initiate.

Can you confirm who on your side will be the uploader and whether Redwood can provide a pre-packaged CAIQ gap tracker (we can accept XLSX or CSV)? If easier, we can accept staged uploads via a temporary AWS role we create for you — we'll need an external email to send the link to.

High-level ask:
- Baseline CAIQ (latest version) with yes/partial/no per control
- Evidence pointers (S3 links or Drive) for a subset of 60 artifacts we agreed on in discovery
- SOC2 attestation PDF (if you have it on hand)

I'll attach a short upload checklist. If we don't see activity within 7 days we’ll schedule a follow-up.

Best,
Sarah Murphy
Senior Onboarding Manager
Vendr Security

[Attachment: vendr-upload-checklist.txt (text)]

From: nikhil_sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Murphy <sarah.murphy@vendr.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr security portal kickoff: scoped CAIQ and short upload window

Sarah —

Thanks, we can run the 72-hour window but want to coordinate so we don't race tokens. Proposed plan (quick MAP):

1) Today (Jun 4): internal kickoff + prep artifact manifest (Ben + Mina)
2) Jun 5 10:00 AM PT: generate and request Vendr ephemeral role/upload link (I'll be the recipient)
3) Jun 5 10:30 AM — Jun 8 10:30 AM: three-day upload window; Ben will push staged S3 links and Mina will attach SOC2 PDF and CAIQ XLSX
4) Post-upload: Irene to validate sample of 12 controls and share a CAIQ gap tracker back to Sarah

Attachments I'm sending now: evidence_matrix.csv (CSV mapping we use), caiq-gap-tracker.xlsx (template), and a short upload-instructions.txt for our SRE to consume.

Could you confirm the minimum object ACLs you require and if the Vendr role will create pre-signed PUT links or accept a single multi-file archive? Our preference is individual pre-signed PUTs to preserve object-level metadata.

Thanks — looping in Ben and Mina for item ownership.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Security Programs Lead
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: evidence_matrix.csv (CSV)]

From: Sarah Murphy <sarah.murphy@vendr.com>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 07:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr security portal kickoff: scoped CAIQ and short upload window

Thanks Nikhil — plan sounds good. We will: 
- Create an ephemeral AWS role scoped to a single prefix and issue pre-signed PUT links (one per object).
- Expect object ACLs as private; we will validate checksums on ingest.
- Accept the CAIQ XLSX and CSV mapping.

I created the upload session link and sent it to your email (link below). The link is valid for 72 hours from creation (Jun 5 10:00 AM PT to Jun 8 10:00 AM PT). Please confirm when upload starts so we can enable ingestion watchers.

Upload link: https://vendr.onetrust.example/upload/abc123

A couple of small asks:
- If you can mark SOC2 PDF filename with the report year (SOC2_2024_Redwood.pdf) that helps our indexing.
- If there are controls you plan to mark as ‘partial’, include short remediation notes in the CAIQ tracker column "RemediationPlan".

Cheers,
Sarah
Sarah Murphy
Senior Onboarding Manager, Vendr
